title: OtterBox Samsung Galaxy S26 Sole Series Case (Blue or Pink)

comparisons.notes: Official Galaxy S26 Sole Series Case; Real Quiet (Blue) and Xtra Hot (Pink) variants both available at $49.99 (compare-at $59.99 ignored)

amazon_match_notes: Exact ASIN from verified Woot payload for Blue MPN 77-000498 (UPC 840434760114)
writeup: Woot has the OtterBox Sole Series case for the Samsung Galaxy S26 in Blue or Pink for $6.99. OtterBox's own store sells the same case for $49.99, so this is about 86% below the cheapest store we checked. Woot doesn't list the condition, and there's a limit of 3 per customer.
